$comment: Committed registration. The W7 D5 agent reads this at startup to learn the surface before
it connects, so the four tool names, the resource URI and the version must match what the
server actually publishes - tests/test_tool_descriptions.py asserts exactly that, because a
registration that drifts from the server is worse than none: it is a contract a client
trusts and the server does not honour.
THE STDIO COMMAND IS `uv run --directory`, NOT `uvx taxcalc-mcp-server`, AND THAT IS NOT A
STYLE CHOICE. This server depends on taxcalc-ai, a sibling project in this repository that
is published to no package registry. uv resolves it through [tool.uv.sources] while working
inside the project, but the BUILT WHEEL carries a bare `Requires-Dist: taxcalc-ai`, so
`uvx taxcalc-mcp-server` and `pipx install ./dist/*.whl` both fail with 'taxcalc-ai was not
found in the package registry'. `uv run --directory` runs the project in place, where the
path source applies, and works from any working directory. Publishing taxcalc-ai would make
uvx viable; until then this is the command that actually starts the server.
`directory` is relative to the repository root, which is where the W7 D5 agent runs. Claude
Desktop has no working directory of its own and needs an absolute path - see
No credential appears here. The stdio launcher reads its bearer from the environment and
the SSE entry declares only the auth SCHEME, not a token.
